mentions.name: SpecStory
mentions.description: This extension for Cursor and GitHub Copilot lets users save, search, and share their AI chat history from AI-powered IDEs. It captures prompts, responses, refactors, and decision paths so that intent becomes as searchable as code, with a long-term goal of building a canonical intent layer for AI-built codebases — like git log/blame, but for why things changed, not just what.
mentions.problem: Most AI-first coding tools don't preserve critical context between sessions — prompts, chats, refactors, and decision paths are lost.
mentions.audience: Most AI-first coding tools don't respect how much critical context gets lost between sessions — prompts, chats, refactors, and decision paths are all gone.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on specstory.com which today is an extension for Cursor & Github copilot that allows you to save, search, share your AI chat history.
